scope: Current native5 backup API, caller-selected resource accounting, actual fixture signatures, source/archive invariance and canceled restore-copy.

hunks.old:
# Restore keeps one independently verified pending copy while projecting
    # the current paths into its fresh root. Staged/final hard links share bytes.
    staging_bytes = _round_mib(database_bytes + retained_bytes + fields["other"]["bytes"]
                              + 2*pending_bytes + 2*manifest_bytes + 64*MIB)
hunks.new:
# Current _copy_allowance and _staging_requirement reserve two copies of
    # every declared archive-data byte, plus both bounded manifest encodings.
    # Published hard links do not reduce the verifier's independent copy plan.
    archive_data_bound = database_bytes + retained_bytes + fields["other"]["bytes"] + pending_bytes
    staging_bytes = _round_mib(2*archive_data_bound + 2*manifest_bytes + 64*MIB)

hunks.old: archive_bound = database_bytes + retained_bytes + fields["other"]["bytes"] + pending_bytes + manifest_bytes

resolved_finding.new: Two copies of all declared archive data plus two manifest limits and the original 64 MiB margin; selected before archive creation.
resolved_finding.regression: A fully written, fsynced and inventoried 65 MiB input proves current _copy_allowance before and after the complete declared data. This input is not claimed to have been imported or archived.
